name: Explosive Rounds
author: Sixth Front
description: Press B (or the HE AMMO button) to load high-explosive rounds. Every bullet you fire bursts on impact and chips away at walls, but each round hits a little softer.
script: // Hooks used: bindKey, hud.text, store, on('bulletHit'), filter('fire'), explode
const show = () => api.hud.text('ammo', he ? 'HE ROUNDS  [B]' : 'BALL AMMO  [B]', { x: 50, y: 90, size: 0.7, color: he ? '#ff9a4a' : '#e8eae3' });
// Each of your bullets bursts where it lands
api.explode(hit.x, hit.y, hit.z, { radius: 1.8, damage: 24, structural: 40, vehicle: 10, size: 0.25, owner: hit.shooter, name: 'HE ROUND' });
// ...but the bullet itself does less damage
